source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Guest Networks' (PDF 17): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Guest network visitors (mehmanon) ko internet istemal karne deta hai. Yeh ghar ke main network se alag hota hai. Guest users personal (zaati) devices tak nahi pohanch sakte. Is se network ki safety (hifazat) aur privacy (raazdari) barhti hai. Guest networks internet ke istemal ko control karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh gharon aur offices mein useful (faidemand) hain.

blocks.prompt: Mehman ko main Wi-Fi ke bajaye guest network kyun dena chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Guest network alag hota hai, is liye mehman ghar ke computers, printer ya files tak nahi pohanch sakta; hifazat aur privacy barhti hai aur internet ka istemal control hota hai.

items: Guest network: mehmanon ke liye alag network; zaati devices tak pohanch nahi; safety, privacy aur control.
